desc:
Welcome to Dinosaur Park Roleplay!

Here you can learn more about those beasts from the Jurassic and the Cretaceous. 
Either become a Park Visitor and see how those beasts live all together or control a Dinosaur yourself and try to live as a pack.

Climb through the ranks, experience Site Apex with different teams and learn more about Dinosaurs.

Roblox Premium members earn 25% more cash and XP, and it stacks with gamepasses and boosts.
